summary: Recorded the forwarded-completion result for the postponed-read question and repaired the wiring that made part of that receipt inconclusive. CheckRun f6f942daf8df40abb36626675d6923fb resolved the forwarded witness as violated (parsed index 20: applying the committed removal performed the leader's first term-2 commit, committed 10 -> 11 with committed_entry_term 2 equal to leader_term, yet readindex_responses_emitted 0 and follower 2 holding no ReadState while pending_reads stayed 1) and its release control as holds (index 23: the unrelated proposal produced one MsgReadIndexResp to follower 2 with ctx A and index 12), with the forwarded premise indices 18 and 19 in between; four other comparisons of that run came back unknown because the forwarded case reused the shared event names, so the aliases of the earlier comparisons admitted operations with no result observation of their own - those equivalent local comparisons are already resolved by receipt 5d77b839c94544d1bf81b71c506a5b90, and joint_history now records why the two receipts are comparable (same harness family, same fixture, same fault model and same interval). The account therefore states that a request the leader accepted can stay unanswered across a commit of an entry of its term when switchToConfig performs that commit, for both consumers of the answer (local ReadState and forwarded MsgReadIndexResp), with the eventual index safe but late; the harness now emits only fwd_-prefixed events for that case and the corrected basis is submitted for a fresh execution, and the question's stale discriminator was replaced by the remaining open premises (reachability without the documented applied/ApplyConfChange latitude, and consequences beyond the unanswered caller). Limitation kept: no state machine was run, so the measured consequence is the unanswered request itself, not a served value.
